summary:
Turn 69 strengthened the headline finding so it no longer rests on an installed record: the committed value is now produced by a real proposal and commit round.

What changed in the harness. The earlier C1 artifacts installed the peer's COMMITTED record directly, which the reviews recorded as their main applicability limit. The new harness drives the history: replica 1, the owner and leader of instance (1,0), admits a client proposal with handlePropose, sends the PreAccept to replica 2, receives its reply, fast-commits and broadcasts the Commit, which replica 2 installs. All of that runs through the unmodified handlers and message codecs. The recovering replica 0 then holds only a default record and runs recovery as before.

The local construction run reproduced everything the confirmed finding claims, now on that driven history: the proposal event shows the owner and the installing replica both at status 4 (COMMITTED) with a real PUT; the recovery resolution still does not adopt the reply that reports the instance COMMITTED (adopted_committed false); the accept round still completes and commits a NOOP vector (vectors_match false); after the recoverer's Commit broadcast the replicas still disagree (replica0 NONE, replica1 and replica2 PUT, all_committed_match false); and the applied state still diverges (recoverer (void) against 04 at both other replicas).

Product. A new artifact on the same unit (unit-C1-recovery-adopts-committed-vector) with the reviewed three-property plan and the strengthened harness, submitted for execution by the trusted runner and a fresh correspondence review. The obligation, predicates, prerequisites, identity correlation and plan are unchanged; only the input history is upgraded from an installed record to a driven proposal, so a reviewer can now assess the finding without the prepared-record caveat, while the remaining limits (the recovery entered directly, the N=3 Thrifty configuration) stay declared. Audit spec moved to version 14; the ten settled claims, the two paused candidates and the recorded open items are untouched, and no requirement, premise or earlier observation was weakened.
